architecture_verdict.placement: domain_objects (outside the frozen entity enum, unreferenced by VersionRef, unversioned) is ACCEPTABLE for this DEVELOPMENT/FIXTURE qualification card and is strictly better than round-2's domain_versions placement, which broke recovery. putOpaque writes only current-state rows with a monotonic revision compare-and-set, business entities remain properly versioned, and no accepted read path, backupInventory, or the shared restore per-kind validator chokes on the new kinds (verified). It is NOT the final architecture: domain_objects is the contract-entity store and four non-contract, history-less, migration-less kinds now live in it, so backup/recovery correctness silently depends on 'these kinds never enter domain_versions' and the entity_revision_digest / portable.json enumeration now carries non-schema rows. The clean home is promotion to $defs entities or dedicated additive tables owned via a migration.
architecture_verdict.required_action: Do NOT re-scope W04-01 to write a migration (migrations/ and backup.go are outside write_scope). Require a registered obligation on the card that owns migrations/ + schema/backup (W04-02/W08 or the W02 registry owner) to give these records a contract/owned home before the W04 parent gate or any LIVE acceptance, and require this card's receipt to state the coupling plainly.
